messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: Repulsion-based force model with triangle-area potential

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "A repulsion-based force model with potential energy U = -Σ min_{triples(i,j,k)} Area(i,j,k)^α (α≈2) converges to a 13-point configuration in [0,1]² whose minimum triangle area equals 1/140, attained by a near-regular arrangement with one interior point placed at the centroid and twelve boundary points distributed with D_6 symmetry; this configuration is a local optimum of the minimum-area functional, and perturbing any single point by ε decreases the minimum triangle area by O(ε²)."}
